data.output:
I re-checked the source at `0845768`. Six of my seven earlier findings are resolved (the capacity finding is an approved boundary). The other one, unclear refusal messages, is only partly fixed. I also found one new confirmed defect: the Export portable ThreeMD menu stays enabled while a replace confirmation is waiting. I did not edit, build, run tests or launch the app. I can't call `Write` or `ExitPlanMode` in this session, so no plan file was written.

## Status of prior findings

| # | Prior finding | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Silent overwrite; start cell can't be chosen without painting | **Resolved** | The Select brush returns before painting (`SculptureCompositionEditor.swift:223`). `selectCell` changes no history or revision (`:206-211`). Occupied targets are held for confirmation (`:547-555`). Confirming re-checks the revision, portable snapshot, start cell and full parent (`:501-507`). The caption is updated (`:1159`). |
| 2 | Refusals don't name the file or the needed tile size | **Partly resolved** | Read and decode failures now name the file (`SculptureInsertionFiles.swift:28-32, 108-118`). Fit failures give the title plus needed and current sizes, with no generated ID (`:36-61`). One gap remains (D2 below). |
| 3 | Scenes over the portable limit refuse insertion | **Approved boundary** | Documented at `docs/file-insertion.md:15`, with a boundary test at `SculptureSceneInsertionTests.swift:229`. No change recommended. |
| 4 | Nested maps show as "Nested map"/"Map insert-model-N" | **Resolved while a portable snapshot exists** | Titles are taken from the snapshot (`SculptureThreeMDCodec.swift:36-39, 239`; `SculptureCompositionEditor.swift:175-178`; `SculptureWorldEditor.swift:111-117`). Tests: `SculptureSceneInsertionTests.swift:88`, `SculptureInsertionDraftTests.swift:48, 94`. |
| 5 | Path sort drops selection order | Unchanged (Low) | Deliberate deterministic path order (`SculptureInsertionFiles.swift:14`), tested at `SculptureInsertionDraftTests.swift:197-212`. The "selection order" comment at `SculptureSceneInsertion.swift:18` is still slightly misleading. |
| 6 | "Use in a world" enabled during insertion | **Resolved** | `canUseInWorld` is false while busy (`:145-146`). The button is disabled and guarded (`:1246-1250`). Tested at `:395, 474, 478`. |
| 7 | Nit: `sculpt-storage` marker in child definitions | Unchanged (Nit) | — |

The world focus guards hold. The prepared result is refused unless the document revision, portable snapshot, parent, focus and all three coordinate strings still match (`SculptureWorldEditor.swift:274-282`). Tests cover a committed focus change, an uncommitted coordinate edit and a save completing mid-preparation (`SculptureInsertionDraftTests.swift:527-568`).

## Remaining defects (confirmed from source)

**D1. Medium: Export portable ThreeMD skips the pending-confirmation guard, which breaks the guarantee in `docs/file-insertion.md:9`.**
- `SculptureEditor.swift:1335`: for a composition sheet, `portableActions` only checks `!draft.isPreparing`. It does not check `draft.isBusy`, which also covers `pendingInsertion` (`SculptureCompositionEditor.swift:145`).
- So the menu (`SculptureDocumentCommands.swift:61-65`, published at `SculptureEditor.swift:144`) stays enabled while the "Replace N occupied tiles?" sheet is open.
- If chosen, `exportPortable` (`:1352-1355`) captures the composition from before the insertion and sets `sheet = nil`. The editor's `onDisappear` then calls `draft.cancelPreparation()` (`SculptureCompositionEditor.swift:906`), which throws the pending candidate away without any message. After the export, `restoreGraphAfterSave` reopens the draft with no pending insertion.
- No data is lost and nothing is published by mistake, but the confirmation is silently dropped. The doc says publication is disabled while confirmation is pending.
- **Repro:** open a new composition (cell 0 is occupied), insert one `.3md`, wait for the confirmation sheet, then choose File → Export portable ThreeMD → Readable 3md copy…
- **Not verified at runtime:** whether SwiftUI keeps that menu enabled while a second, nested sheet is open. It does work while the composition sheet alone is open, which is how it was designed.
- **Fix:** change the composition case at `:1335` to `!draft.isBusy`.
- The world case at `:1337` is already correct, because world insertion uses `isOpeningModel`.

**D2. Low–Medium: a sparse-world file in a batch is still refused without its filename.**
- `SculptureOpenedScene.decode` accepts world files (`SculpturePortableInterchange.swift:211-212`). `validateFit` skips them (`SculptureInsertionFiles.swift:50`).
- The refusal therefore comes later, from `importing` (`SculptureSceneInsertion.swift:164`). By then the URL is gone, and the message reads: "Insert a voxel model or composition. A sparse world cannot be used as a child model."
- The doc sentence "Read failures identify the source filename" is technically true, because this isn't a read failure. But this was exactly the folder case in my earlier finding 2.
- **Repro:** select `a.3md` (voxel) and `world.3md` (sparse world), or a 64-file folder containing one world file, and use Insert 3md. The message doesn't say which file caused it.
- **Fix:** in `read(_:)`, after decoding, refuse `.world` scenes with `sourceFailure(SculptureInsertionError.unsupportedChild, at: url)`. This is host-only; the core result DTO doesn't change.

## Low UX notes (not defects)

- The default brush is still Place (`SculptureCompositionEditor.swift:112`). Clicking a library model switches the brush back to Place (`:198`). So "Select, then pick a model, then click a tile" paints that tile. Undo recovers it, but Select doesn't stay selected.
- Composition `retainPortableSnapshot` cancels any preparation or confirmation silently (`:309`). The world editor reports `parentChanged` in the same situation. In the current host this doesn't seem reachable, because the sheet is dismissed during saves.
- When a native, non-portable composition with deeper nested maps is inserted, those inner maps are titled with their source model ID (`SculptureThreeMDCodec.swift:239`). They appear that way in the world model picker. This is display only.
- In world Explore mode, the canvas stays live while preparing. WASD movement changes the focus, so the result is safely refused with "parent changed".

## Coverage risks (unproven, not defects)

- No test that portable actions are unavailable while an insertion is pending (D1).
- No test that a world-scene file in a batch gives a refusal naming the file (D2). `SculptureInsertionDraftTests.swift:116, 187` only checks the raw `unsupportedChild`.
- No test that selecting a library model resets the Select brush.
- Not checked natively: real panel grants, the nested-sheet menu behaviour, the confirmation sheet's Escape/Cancel binding (`:915-923`), and the full Insert → confirm → Undo → save flow.
- New editor tests in `SculptureInsertionDraftTests.swift:362-608` cover Select, confirm/cancel, stale-ID refusal, invalidation by parent, start cell and snapshot changes, edits and saves during preparation, the world focus and snapshot guards, named-file errors and fit errors.

Full local verification and the actual native interaction are still pending. I claim neither runtime success nor human approval. This is agent review evidence, not an independent human review or signature.

SCULPT_CLAUDE_RECHECK_DONE
